module_summary: AXI-stream SRL FIFO: input beats (data plus enabled sidebands) shift into a shift-register array; an occupancy pointer selects the oldest entry for output, with registered full/empty flags driving ready/valid.

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: shift-register array of packed beats; shifts in s_axis on shift

anchors.name: ptr_reg
anchors.why: occupancy count; indexes oldest entry and drives count

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: input beat valid; with tready triggers shift/inc

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: input payload packed into s_axis word

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: output ready; with valid decrements pointer

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: output payload from selected entry m_axis

anchors.name: shift
anchors.why: shift enable for data_reg on accepted input beat

anchors.name: dec
anchors.why: decrements ptr_reg occupancy on output pop

anchors.name: m_axis
anchors.why: oldest packed entry data_reg[ptr_reg-1], unpacked to outputs

groups.name: SRL storage
groups.description: Shift-register array with input packing and pointer-indexed output

groups.name: Occupancy control
groups.description: Pointer inc/dec and full/empty flags producing ready/valid
